title: Bunny Boss Mech
author: blendgame
selftext:
This is a boss character I’m currently working on.   
I also released a demo recently!

For this mech, I used Astra to develop a mechanically functional structure and focused on making it work as an in-game asset rather than just a concept render. The modeling approach was based on boolean-driven, non-uniform forms instead of simple primitive blockouts, which helped create a more distinctive mechanical silhouette. Most of the smaller details were pushed into the texture work rather than modeled directly, which made it possible to keep the final mesh to roughly 30k triangles.  
I also completed the IK setup, and the mech has already been implemented in the game and tested as an actual gameplay asset. One of the more interesting parts of the process was balancing visual complexity with game-readiness while still keeping the structure mechanically believable.
